8.title: NIC Bytes Received
8.query:
timeseries { avg(dt.host.net.nic.bytes_rx), value.A = avg(dt.host.net.nic.bytes_rx, scalar: true) }, by: { host.name }
| filter in (host.name, array($Host_Name))

10.title: NIC Bytes Sent On Host
10.query:
timeseries { avg(dt.host.net.nic.bytes_tx), value.A = avg(dt.host.net.nic.bytes_tx, scalar: true) }, by: { host.name }
| filter in (host.name, array($Host_Name))

11.title: NIC Packet Received
11.query:
timeseries { avg(dt.host.net.nic.packets.rx), value.A = avg(dt.host.net.nic.packets.rx, scalar: true) }, by: { host.name }
| filter in (host.name, array($Host_Name))

12.title: NIC Packet Sent
12.query:
timeseries { avg(dt.host.net.nic.packets.tx), value.A = avg(dt.host.net.nic.packets.tx, scalar: true) }, by: { host.name }
| filter in (host.name, array($Host_Name))

13.title: Number of Request/s
13.query:
timeseries { avg(dt.process.network.load), value.A = avg(dt.process.network.load, scalar: true) }, by: { host.name }
| filter in (host.name, array($Host_Name))
